tagline: Clear, calm, personalized explanations of your doctor's advice

safety.prototypeBannerBody: MedSarthi is an AI-thon educational prototype using synthetic cases only. It is NOT clinically validated, does not diagnose or prescribe, and must not replace a qualified doctor.
safety.prototypeFooter: Educational Prototype • Synthetic Data Only • Not Clinically Validated for Real Care • Always confirm medical decisions with your doctor.
safety.emergencyNote: If you have severe chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden weakness, or heavy bleeding, call 112 / 108 or go to the nearest emergency hospital immediately.
safety.emergencySeekCare: Do not wait for an app reply. Please call emergency services (112 or 108) or go to the nearest emergency hospital right away.
safety.integrityPassed: Safety Check Passed — Key medicines, doses, timing, and warnings match your doctor's note.
safety.integrityWarning: Safety Check Notice — Please double-check the highlighted details with your doctor or pharmacist.
safety.integrityBlocked: Safety Hold — This explanation could not be verified against the doctor's original note and is held for review.
safety.integrityDisclaimer: Automated consistency check comparing critical fields against the source note; this does not prove clinical correctness or replace professional review.
safety.medicineProhibition: Never start, stop, or change any medicine dose without asking your doctor or pharmacist.

patientHome.greeting: How can MedSarthi help you today?
patientHome.subtitle: Pick one option below. You can change language, text size, or audio speed anytime at the top.

actions.instructionsHint: Read or listen to your visit summary in simple words
actions.reportHint: Upload a lab report or prescription and verify unclear text
actions.medicineHint: See how and when to take each medicine safely
actions.talkHint: Ask questions by voice or text in English, Hindi, or Hinglish
actions.listenHint: Play audio with slow/fast speed and live word highlighting
actions.historyHint: Review past visits and look up medical terms

onboarding.title: Let's personalize MedSarthi for you
onboarding.step1Hint: Enter your first name or the name you prefer. We will only use it gently to greet you.
onboarding.step2Hint: This only helps us pick comfortable starting text size and audio speed. You can change them anytime.
onboarding.step3Hint: You may skip this. It never changes how simply or respectfully we explain things.
onboarding.step4Title: How comfortable are you with reading and understanding medical information?
onboarding.step4Hint: Pick what feels best for you today. You can change detail level anytime.

comfortDescriptions.very_simple: Short everyday words and easy step-by-step points
comfortDescriptions.simple: Clear plain language with everyday meanings for medical words
comfortDescriptions.comfortable: Detailed explanations alongside clear medical terms
comfortDescriptions.adaptive: Show a clear summary with Simpler / More Detail buttons on every answer

onboarding.step5Title: Which language feels easiest for you?
onboarding.step5Hint: Search or tap below. You can switch languages anytime without losing your place.
onboarding.step5HinglishNote: Hindi written in English letters (e.g. 'Khaane ke baad ek goli lein')
onboarding.step6Title: How would you like MedSarthi to explain things?
onboarding.step6Hint: Choose the format that works best on your phone or computer.

formatOptions.audioDesc: Listen calmly with Play, Pause, and Speed controls
formatOptions.text_audioDesc: Read along while each sentence is highlighted and spoken
formatOptions.visualDesc: Simple verified pictures paired with short explanations

onboarding.step7Hint: We chose comfortable starting settings based on your age. Adjust them anytime.
